titulo: I asked my mom to Google me
hooks: I asked my mom to Google me
What shows up when people Google you?

mensajes.texto: A gorgeous ironworks shop, photos and all
Further down. My old Facebook photo
Oh, yes. You were so skinny
I asked the other one for a quote

contenido.remate: Even my mom went with the competition

captions: If people search for you and another business shows up with photos, hours and quotes while you show up with an old Facebook photo, you know who they're calling. Even if it's your mom.
Try this: ask someone to Google your business and tell you what they see. Sometimes it stings, but it helps.
Your competitors can do worse work than you and still land the customer, because when people search for them, they show up complete.
